results.question: How many schools with an average score in Math greater than 400 in the SAT test are exclusively virtual?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.School) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.Virtual = 'F' AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) AS virtual_schools_math_gt_400 FROM schools s JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND sc.AvgScrMath > 400;

results.question: Please list the codes of the schools with a total enrollment of over 500.
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.CDSCode FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` + T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 500
results.sql: SELECT s.CDSCode FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 500 LIMIT 50;

results.question: Which are the cards that have incredibly powerful foils.
results.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
results.sql: SELECT name, power, toughness, convertedManaCost, setCode FROM cards WHERE hasFoil = 1 AND power > 10 ORDER BY power DESC LIMIT 50;

results.question: What are the borderless cards available without powerful foils?
results.gold_sql: SELECT id FROM cards WHERE borderColor = 'borderless' AND (cardKingdomId IS NULL OR cardKingdomId IS NULL)
results.sql: SELECT name, setCode, isFullArt, hasFoil FROM cards WHERE isFullArt = 1 AND hasFoil = 0 LIMIT 50;

results.question: Which user has a higher reputation, Harlan or Jarrod Dixon?
results.gold_sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') AND Reputation = ( SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon') )
results.sql: SELECT DisplayName, Reputation FROM users WHERE DisplayName IN ('Harlan', 'Jarrod Dixon');

results.question: Please list the display names of all the users whose accounts were created in the year 2011.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011'
results.sql: SELECT DisplayName FROM users WHERE strftime('%Y', CreationDate) = '2011' LIMIT 50;

results.question: What is the ratio of customers who pay in EUR against customers who pay in CZK?
results.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(Currency = 'EUR', 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) / SUM(IIF(Currency = 'CZK', 1, 0)) AS ratio FROM customers

results.question: How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'
results.sql: SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS total_consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = '6' AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

results.question: Give the team_fifa_api_id of teams with more than 50 but less than 60 build-up play speed.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60 LIMIT 50;

results.question: Find the average number of long-shot done by Ahmed Samir Farag.
results.gold_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.long_shots) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.`date`) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'
results.sql: SELECT AVG(pa.long_shots) AS avg_long_shots FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

results.question: List out the no. of districts that have female average salary is more than 6000 but less than 10000?
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.district_id)  FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T2.A11 BETWEEN 6000 AND 10000

results.question: For the female client who was born in 1976/1/29, which district did she opened her account?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.A2 FROM district AS T1 INNER JOIN client AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id WHERE T2.birth_date = '1976-01-29' AND T2.gender = 'F'

results.question: What is the surname of the driver with the best lap time in race number 19 in the second qualifying period?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.surname FROM qualifying AS T1 INNER JOIN drivers AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId WHERE T1.raceId = 19 ORDER BY T1.q2 ASC LIMIT 1
results.sql: SELECT d.surname FROM qualifying q JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId WHERE q.raceId = 19 AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY q.q2 ASC LIMIT 1;

results.question: Please give the name of the race held on the circuits in Germany.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.name FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T1.country = 'Germany'
results.sql: SELECT r.name FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE c.country = 'Germany' LIMIT 50;

results.question: What's Angela Sanders's major?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Angela' AND T1.last_name = 'Sanders'
results.sql: SELECT m.major_name FROM member mem JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id WHERE mem.first_name = 'Angela' AND mem.last_name = 'Sanders' LIMIT 1;

results.question: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.amount FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'
results.sql: SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_funds_received FROM member m JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'

results.question: Please list all the superpowers of 3-D Man.
results.gold_sql: SELECT T3.power_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = '3-D Man'
results.sql: SELECT sp.power_name FROM superhero sh JOIN hero_power hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id WHERE sh.superhero_name = '3-D Man'

results.question: What is Copycat's race?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T2.race FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.race_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name = 'Copycat'
results.sql: SELECT r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat' LIMIT 1;

results.question: What is the disease patient '30609' diagnosed with. List all the date of laboratory tests done for this patient.
results.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.ID = 30609
results.sql: SELECT p.Diagnosis AS patient_diagnosis, e.Diagnosis AS examination_diagnosis, l.Date AS lab_date FROM Patient p LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.ID = '30609' ORDER BY l.Date;

results.question: List the patient ID, sex and birthday of patient with LDH beyond normal range.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH > 500
results.sql: SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday FROM Patient p INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.LDH > 280 OR l.LDH < 140 LIMIT 50;

results.question: What is the most common bond type?
results.gold_sql: SELECT T.bond_type FROM ( SELECT bond_type, COUNT(bond_id) FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY COUNT(bond_id) DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS T
results.sql: SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

results.question: Find the triple-bonded molecules which are carcinogenic.
results.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.molecule_id FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '#' AND T2.label = '+'
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE b.bond_type = '#' AND m.label = '+';
